verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies the restored Old Post Office building in Washington D.C.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elegantly restored to its historic grandeur, the iconic Old Post Office has been reimagined as Waldorf Astoria Washington DC.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Pennsylvania Avenue between the White House and the U.S. Capitol, near the National Mall museums, the Washington Monument and the Lincoln Memorial.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel sits on Pennsylvania Avenue between The White House and the U.S. Capitol near National Mall museums, the Washington Monument, and Lincoln Memorial.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served beneath the hotel's atrium, with savory bites, scones, pastries and free-flowing champagne.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meet us at the clock for Afternoon Tea beneath our soaring atrium — savory bites, scones, exquisite pastries, and free-flowing champagne await.

verified_facts.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa has treatment rooms including a couple's suite and a Himalayan Salt Therapy Room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate the mind, body, and soul at the Waldorf Astoria Spa, featuring six luxurious treatment rooms, including a couple’s suite and a soothing Himalayan Salt Therapy Room.

verified_facts.text: Peacock Alley serves cocktails beneath crystal sconces and chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sip cocktails under the glittering crystal sconces and chandeliers in Peacock Alley

verified_facts.text: The hotel has The Bazaar by José Andrés, with cuisine rooted in Spanish heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: step into a world of culinary imagination rooted in Spanish heritage and layered with luxurious detail at The Bazaar by José Andrés

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: In-room dining is also available 24 hours for your comfort and convenience.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has 34,000 square feet of event space.
verified_facts.excerpt: With 34,000 sq. ft. of event space, Waldorf Astoria Washington DC offers the most spectacular setting for your next event.

verified_facts.text: Event venues include the Grand Ballroom, the historic Lincoln Library and the Franklin Study.
verified_facts.excerpt: Host a glamorous reception in the Grand Ballroom or choose from the historic Lincoln Library or Franklin Study for prestigious meetings and gatherings.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites offer views of Pennsylvania Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy spectacular views of Pennsylvania Avenue, exquisite furnishings, and luxury amenities.

verified_facts.text: Construction of the Romanesque Revival building began in 1892 as headquarters for the US Post Office Department.
verified_facts.excerpt: Construction began in 1892 for this Romanesque Revival-style structure as a grand HQ for the US Post Office Department

verified_facts.text: A nine-story atrium serves as the hotel's lobby and its main restaurant and bar, Peacock Alley.

verified_facts.text: Original details such as arching metal truss-work are preserved alongside new oversized chandeliers and velvet couches.
